part.text:
Implemented the fix in `src/diff/props.js:230`: when a DOM property is set to `null`/`undefined`, `contentEditable` now receives `'inherit'` instead of the invalid empty string, preventing the browser exception.

The render browser tests pass, including the new `contentEditable` case (64/64).
